steps.message:
Item 054 on the verification register for Birchwood Village Expansion, Package A has to close before 07/20/2026. It covers the slab-on-grade fill compaction testing Vantree ran on 07/08/2026 and their Field Density Report SF-26-0708, issued the next day.

Work those results against Specification Section 31 20 00, Earth Moving, and give me an acceptance determination. State the acceptance basis you are using, the limits it produces, and what in the record establishes that basis for this fill.

Cover the testing as well as the results. I want to know whether what was done and recorded is enough to support the determination under that section, and what has to be in hand before anything is built on this fill.

Two files are attached: Fill_Placement_Records_BlockA_SlabOnGrade.xlsx, the Contractor's placement log for this fill, and Thelbridge_Materials_Acceptance_Record_TEMPLATE.docx, our house format for a materials acceptance record. Use the template and save the finished record as /filesystem/Thelbridge_Materials_Acceptance_Fill_Compaction_2026-0708.docx.

3.4   COMPACTION
A.   Method Statement. The Contractor shall place structural fill in controlled lifts as specified in
Article 3.3, moisture-conditioning each lift as necessary to bring the material within the
moisture range required by Article 3.4.B before compaction. Compaction equipment
(self-propelled vibratory smooth-drum rollers, pad-foot rollers, or plate compactors adjacent to
structures) shall be operated in a pattern of overlapping passes such that every location
within a lift receives no fewer than the number of passes established during a
Contractor-conducted test strip witnessed by the Laboratory and the Owner's Representative
Engineer. The test strip shall be executed at the start of production placement, using the
placement source, moisture-conditioning method, lift thickness, and compaction equipment
intended for production, and shall demonstrate that the criteria of Article 3.4.B are met before
general production is authorized. Adjacent to walls, columns, and utilities, use hand-operated
compaction equipment in lifts not exceeding 6 inches loose thickness. Do not operate heavy
compaction equipment within 3 feet of walls prior to backfill balancing on both sides. Each lift
shall be tested and accepted per Article 3.4.B before the next lift is placed.
B.   Acceptance Criteria.
Structural fill shall be placed and compacted to a dry density of not less than
95% of the maximum dry density determined by ASTM D1557 Method C for the
placed material, AND shall be placed at a moisture content within −1% to +2%
of the optimum moisture content determined by the same test. Both criteria must
be satisfied for each test location. Field density shall be measured per ASTM
D6938 (nuclear gauge, direct-transmission mode) at a frequency of one test per
5,000 sf per lift.

not satisfied at any test location:
1.   The affected area of the lift shall be reworked (scarified, moisture-conditioned, and
recompacted, or removed and replaced) at the Contractor's expense.
2.   Reworked areas shall be retested by the Laboratory. Both the density and moisture
criteria of Article 3.4.B must be satisfied on the retest before the lift is accepted.

structures) shall be operated in a pattern of overlapping passes such that every location
within a lift receives no fewer than the number of passes established during a
Contractor-conducted test strip witnessed by the Laboratory and the Owner's Representative

placement source, moisture-conditioning method, lift thickness, and compaction equipment

general production is authorized. Adjacent to walls, columns, and utilities, use hand-operated

P23: •  Articles 1.2.A.1 & 1.2.A.2 (Referenced Compaction Standards): ASTM D698 Standard Proctor is for historical borrow characterization only and is excluded as an acceptance basis for Package A structural fill per Article 1.2.A.1. Article 1.2.A.1 explicitly restricts ASTM D698 (Standard Proctor, 12,375 ft-lbf/ft³) to 'historical borrow characterization only; not the acceptance basis for Package A structural fill.' Article 1.2.A.2 establishes ASTM D1557 (Modified Proctor, 56,000 ft-lbf/ft³) as the 'Governing laboratory reference for Package A structural fill.' Article 1.2.A.3 establishes ASTM D6938 as the governing field density test method.
P24: •  Articles 1.3.A, 1.3.C–E, 1.4.C, & 2.1.A–D (Material Qualification & Placed-Material Correspondence): Structural fill beneath slabs-on-grade (Article 1.3.A) must be well-graded granular fill classified USCS SM or SW-SM (Article 2.1.A), with ≤ 12% passing the No. 200 sieve and Plasticity Index (PI) ≤ 6 (Article 2.1.B), free of organic/deleterious matter and particles > 3 in (Article 2.1.C). Under Article 1.3.E, Article 1.4.C, and Article 2.1.D, the laboratory maximum dry density (γd,max) and optimum moisture content (wopt) used as the acceptance denominators for any test location must be those determined prior to placement by ASTM D1557 Method C on the material actually placed at that location. Where placed material differs materially from previously characterized borrow, a new ASTM D1557 Method C test must be performed before further fill placement is accepted (Article 1.4.C; Article 3.7.A.2).
P25: •  Articles 3.4.B, 3.4.C.1–3, & 3.4.D (Compaction & Moisture Acceptance Criteria, Non-Averaging Rule, & Interpretation): Article 3.4.B requires that structural fill 'shall be placed and compacted to a dry density of not less than 95% of the maximum dry density determined by ASTM D1557 Method C for the placed material, AND shall be placed at a moisture content within −1% to +2% of the optimum moisture content determined by the same test. Both criteria must be satisfied for each test location.' Averaging isolated failing field density or moisture tests with adjacent passing tests is prohibited per Article 3.4.C.3; specifically, Article 3.4.C.3 mandates that 'Isolated failing tests may not be averaged with adjacent passing tests to demonstrate compliance. Acceptance is evaluated at each test location independently.' Article 3.4.D reinforces that 'No test location shall be accepted on the basis of density alone. No test location shall be accepted on the basis of moisture alone.' Under Articles 3.4.C.1–2, any location failing either criterion must be reworked (scarified, moisture-conditioned, and recompacted, or removed and replaced) and retested until both criteria pass.
P26: •  Articles 1.4.A–B, 1.5.A–B, 1.6.A–B, 3.2.A–B, 3.3.A–B, 3.4.A, 3.7.A.1, 3.7.B–C, & 3.8.A (Execution, Frequency, Reporting, & Non-Conforming Work): Subgrade must be stripped and proof-rolled with a loaded tandem-axle dump truck in the presence of the Laboratory and accepted in writing by Thelbridge prior to fill placement (Articles 1.6.A, 3.2.A–B). Fill must be placed in horizontal lifts ≤ 12 in loose thickness (Article 3.3.A), moisture-conditioned (Article 3.3.B), and tested/accepted lift-by-lift before placing the succeeding lift (Articles 1.6.B, 3.4.A). Field density testing per ASTM D6938 (direct-transmission mode, with current gauge calibration and daily start-of-shift standard-count check per Article 1.4.B) is required at a frequency of 1 test per 5,000 sf per lift, and not fewer than 3 tests per lift (min 3 / minimum 3 tests per lift regardless of lift area) (Articles 3.4.B, 3.7.A.1). Under Articles 1.5.B.1 and 3.7.B, field density reports must be issued within 24 hours and state, for each test location, the ASTM D1557 Method C γd,max and wopt denominators, measured dry density, measured moisture content, percent compaction, moisture deviation from optimum, and disposition (accept or reject) against Article 3.4.B. Under Article 3.7.C, any lift not meeting Article 3.4.B, OR any lift for which the ASTM D1557 Method C denominators used in reporting do not correspond to the material actually placed, must be reworked per Article 3.4.C. Under Article 1.3.E, Article 1.4.C, and Article 2.1.D, the laboratory maximum dry density (γd,max) and optimum moisture content (wopt) used as the acceptance denominators for any test location must be those determined prior to placement by ASTM D1557 Method C on the material actually placed at that location. Where placed material differs materially from previously characterized borrow, a new ASTM D1557 Method C test must be performed before further fill placement is accepted (Article 1.4.C; Article 3.7.A.2).

Both criteria must be satisfied for each test location.' Averaging isolated failing field density or moisture tests with adjacent passing tests is prohibited per Article 3.4.C.3; specifically, Article 3.4.C.3 mandates that 'Isolated failing tests may not be averaged with adjacent passing tests to demonstrate compliance. The Materials Acceptance Record for **Verification Register Item 054** (tracked under Progress Meeting No. 26 Action Item **`AI-26-04`**, due `07/16/2026` [`2026-07-16`], and required to close on or before `07/20/2026` [`2026-07-20`]) has been updated, verified, and saved to:

- **`/filesystem/Thelbridge_Materials_Acceptance_Fill_Compaction_2026-0708.docx`**

---

### 1. Acceptance Determination

- **Formal Determination**: **`REJECTED`**
  1. **Vantree Field Density Report `SF-26-0708` (tested `07/08/2026` [`2026-07-08`], issued `07/09/2026` [`2026-07-09`]) and Lift 6 (El. `748.6 ft`) of the Block A Slab-on-Grade Structural Fill Pad (Grids B–G / 1–5) are `REJECTED`** under **Specification 31 20 00 (Earth Moving, Rev. 3, `03/06/2026` [`2026-03-06`]) Articles 1.2.A.1–2, 1.4.C, 2.1.D, 3.4.B, 3.4.C.1–3, 3.4.D, and 3.7.B–C**.
  2. Specifically, **Test `FD-14` (Block A, Grid B-3: $w = 6.1\%$, $\Delta w = -3.1\%$)** and **Test `FD-17` (Block A, Grid G-2: $w = 5.8\%$, $\Delta w = -3.4\%$)** on Lift 6 are **`REJECTED`** for failing the mandatory moisture content range of **$8.2\%$ to $11.2\%$** ($-1.0\%$ to $+2.0\%$ of $w_{\text{opt}} = 9.2\%$), even though all four test locations (`FD-14` through `FD-17`) satisfy the minimum dry density criterion ($\ge 122.0\text{ pcf}$ / $\ge 95.0\%$ of $\gamma_{d,\max} = 128.4\text{ pcf}$).
  3. **Report `SF-26-0708` as issued is `REJECTED`** because Vantree evaluated Lift 6 against an invalid **ASTM D698 Standard Proctor** performed on a Phase 1 cohesive clay borrow source (**`VMT-2024-0403-P1B`**, Sample `VMT-24-0325-138`: $\gamma_{d,\max} = 118.6\text{ pcf}$, $w_{\text{opt}} = 12.1\%$) and omitted moisture deviation and moisture-window compliance reporting.
  4. **Record-Date Release Posture (as of `07/15/2026` [`2026-07-15`])**: Overall pad acceptance under **Verification Register `Item 054`** is **`REJECTED / WITHHELD`**. As of the record date, the list of Block A slab-on-grade fill areas released for overlying construction (`3/4 in` crushed-stone capillary break course under Article 2.3.A or cast-in-place concrete slab-on-grade under Specification 03 30 00) is **EMPTY (ZERO areas released)**.

---

### 2. Governing Acceptance Basis, Numerical Limits, and Record Establishment

#### A. Governing Acceptance Basis & Scope Exclusions
- **Governing Specification Basis**: **Specification 31 20 00 (Earth Moving, Rev. 3, `03/06/2026`) Article 3.4.B** (*Compaction and Moisture Criteria — Structural Fill*), **Article 3.4.C.3** (*Non-Averaging Rule*), and **Article 3.4.D** (*Interpretation*).
- **Explicit Scope Exclusions**:
  - *ASTM D698 Standard Proctor is for historical borrow characterization only and is excluded as an acceptance basis for Package A structural fill per Article 1.2.A.1.*
  - *Averaging isolated failing field density or moisture tests with adjacent passing tests is prohibited per Article 3.4.C.3.*
- **Laboratory Compaction Standard**: **ASTM D1557-12(2021) Method C** (Modified Proctor, $56,000\text{ ft-lbf/ft}^3$ compactive effort) per **Vantree Materials Testing Report No. `VMT-25-0918-P04`** (dated `09/18/2025` [`2025-09-18`], Sample ID **`LWP-PA-SF-2025-01`**, Larchwood Pit — Package A Structural Fill, USCS `SM / SW-SM`, $9.4\%$ passing No. 200 sieve, Non-Plastic, $G_s = 2.68$):
  - **Maximum Dry Density ($\gamma_{d,\max}$)**: **$128.4\text{ pcf}$**
  - **Optimum Moisture Content ($w_{\text{opt}}$)**: **$9.2\%$**

#### B. Numerical Acceptance Limits Produced by This Basis
Applying **Article 3.4.B**, **Article 3.4.C.3**, **Article 3.4.D**, and **Article 3.7.A.1** to `VMT-25-0918-P04` ($\gamma_{d,\max} = 128.4\text{ pcf}$, $w_{\text{opt}} = 9.2\%$) produces the following hard limits for the Block A slab-on-grade fill pad ($\text{Plan Area} = 11,400\text{ sf}$):

| Parameter | Governing Reference (`VMT-25-0918-P04`) | Specification 31 20 00 Requirement | Numerical Acceptance Limit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **In-Place Dry Density ($\gamma_d$)** | $\gamma_{d,\max} = 128.4\text{ pcf}$ | $\ge 95.0\%$ of $\gamma_{d,\max}$ (`Art. 3.4.B`) | **$\ge 122.0\text{ pcf}$** ($121.98\text{ pcf}$ exact; $\ge 95.0\%$) |
| **In-Place Moisture Content ($w$)** | $w_{\text{opt}} = 9.2\%$ | $-1.0\%$ to $+2.0\%$ of $w_{\text{opt}}$ (`Art. 3.4.B`) | **$8.2\%$ to $11.2\%$ inclusive** ($\Delta w = -1.0\%$ to $+2.0\%$) |
| **Individual Location Rule** | Each test location (`FD-xx`) | Dual compliance; no averaging (`Arts. 3.4.B, 3.4.C.3, 3.4.D`) | **BOTH** density **AND** moisture must pass at **each location** |
| **Field Test Frequency** | $\text{Plan Area} = 11,400\text{ sf}$ | $1\text{ per }5,000\text{ sf/lift}$, **min 3** / **minimum 3** per lift (`Arts. 3.4.B, 3.7.A.1`) | **Minimum 3 tests per lift** ($\lceil 11,400 / 5,000 \rceil = 3$) |

#### C. What in the Project Record Establishes This Basis for This Fill
1. **Specification 31 20 00 (Rev. 3, `03/06/2026`)**:
   - **Article 1.2.A.1** explicitly restricts **ASTM D698** (Standard Proctor, $12,375\text{ ft-lbf/ft}^3$) to *"historical borrow characterization only; not the acceptance basis for Package A structural fill."*
   - **Article 1.2.A.2** designates **ASTM D1557** (Modified Proctor) as the *"Governing laboratory reference for Package A structural fill."*

### 3. Evaluation of Testing Procedures, Reporting, and Test Results (`SF-26-0708`)

#### A. Evaluation of Field Testing Execution and Reporting (`SF-26-0708`)
1. **Conforming Aspects of Field Execution**:
   - **Subgrade Proof Roll (`Articles 1.6.A & 3.2.A–B`)**: Subgrade at El. `745.0 ft` was proof-rolled with a loaded tandem-axle dump truck on `06/18/2026` (`2026-06-18`) in the presence of Vantree and accepted in writing by Thelbridge under **Memo `TPM-26-063`** (`06/18/2026`).
   - **Production Test Strip & Lift Thickness (`Articles 3.3.A & 3.4.A`)**: Executed `06/19/2026` (`2026-06-19`), witnessed by Vantree and Thelbridge, establishing `8.0 in` (`8 in`) loose lifts (`~7.2 in` compacted, within the $\le 12\text{ in}$ loose limit of Article 3.3.A) compacted with `6` passes of a Caterpillar CS56B smooth-drum vibratory roller and `4` passes of a Caterpillar PS-150C pneumatic roller (with a Wacker DPU 6555 vibratory plate compactor at edges/tie-ins). Six lifts were placed between `06/22/2026` and `07/08/2026` from El. `745.0 ft` to El. `748.6 ft` (`3.6 ft` total fill; `136` haul units; `~1,904 CY` loose / `~1,520 CY` compacted).
   - **Nuclear Gauge Procedure, Calibration, & Frequency on Lift 6 (`Articles 1.2.A.3, 1.4.B, 3.4.B, & 3.7.A.1–B`)**: On `07/08/2026`, Vantree tested 4 locations (`FD-14` through `FD-17`) across the `11,400 sf` Lift 6 surface (`1 test per 2,850 sf`, exceeding the **minimum 3** / **min 3** tests per lift requirement) using a Troxler Model 3440 nuclear gauge (S/N `34-047162`) in direct-transmission mode at a `6.0 in` (`6 in`) probe depth and `60`-second count time. The gauge held a current annual calibration (`02/06/2026` [`2026-02-06`]) and passed its daily start-of-shift standardization check (`2,478` density standard count; `738` moisture standard count). Report `SF-26-0708` was issued on `07/09/2026` (within the 24-hour window of Article 3.7.B).
2. **Critical Reporting Non-Conformances in `SF-26-0708` (`Articles 1.2.A.1–2, 1.4.C, 1.5.B.1, 2.1.A–D, 3.4.B, 3.4.D, & 3.7.B–C`)**:
   - **Wrong Compaction Standard & Wrong Borrow Material Denominators**: Part 3 (§3, p. 1) of `SF-26-0708` evaluated Lift 6 against **`VMT-2024-0403-P1B`** (`04/03/2024` [`2024-04-03`], Sample `VMT-24-0325-138` sampled `03/25/2024` [`2024-03-25`]), an **ASTM D698 Method A (Standard Proctor, $12,375\text{ ft-lbf/ft}^3$)** curve with $\gamma_{d,\max} = 118.6\text{ pcf}$ and $w_{\text{opt}} = 12.1\%$ performed on **Wexford Ridge Borrow (Phase 1 off-site borrow)**—a reddish-brown silty clay of low plasticity (**USCS `CL-ML`**, **$68.0\%$ [$68\%$] passing No. 200 sieve**, $\text{LL} = 32$, $\text{PL} = 21$, $\text{PI} = 11$, $G_s = 2.71$). Using `VMT-2024-0403-P1B` violates Article 1.2.A.1 (which prohibits ASTM D698 as an acceptance basis), Articles 1.4.C and 2.1.A–D (which require denominators from an ASTM D1557 Method C test on the placed granular `SM / SW-SM` material with $\le 12\%$ fines and $\text{PI} \le 6$), and artificially inflated the reported percent compaction by $7.6$ to $8.3$ percentage points (yielding $103.6\%$ to $106.3\%$).

### 4. Sufficiency of What Was Done and Recorded Under Specification 31 20 00

What was done and recorded to date is **sufficient to mandate rejection of `SF-26-0708` and Lift 6**, and is **NOT sufficient to support acceptance of the Block A slab-on-grade fill pad** under Specification 31 20 00 due to three record and compliance deficiencies:
1. **Lift 6 Physical Non-Conformance and Invalid Reporting (`SF-26-0708`)**: Two of the four Lift 6 test locations (`FD-14` at Grid B-3 and `FD-17` at Grid G-2) failed the moisture window on the dry side ($\Delta w = -3.1\%$ and $-3.4\%$), and `SF-26-0708` reported against the prohibited ASTM D698 reference (`VMT-2024-0403-P1B`) without evaluating moisture compliance (`Articles 3.4.B, 3.4.C.3, 3.4.D, 3.7.B–C`).
2. **Missing Field Density Reports `FDR-BA-01` through `FDR-BA-05` for Lifts 1 through 5 (`Articles 1.5.B.1, 1.6.B, & 3.7.B–C`)**: Rowan Bay's placement log (`RB-FPR-BA-2026`, Cover row `R31`; Daily Placement Log rows `R19`–`R23` and `R31`; Note 6; Note 8) states that Lifts 1 through 5 (placed `06/22/2026`, `06/23/2026`, `06/25/2026`, `06/26/2026` [`2026-06-26`], and `06/30/2026` [`2026-06-30`] from El. `745.0 ft` to El. `748.0 ft`) were tested at `3` tests per lift (`15` tests total, covering `FD-01` through `FD-13` plus rework retests across reports **`FDR-BA-01`**, **`FDR-BA-02`**, **`FDR-BA-03`**, **`FDR-BA-04`**, and **`FDR-BA-05`**) and notes surface drying on `06/26/2026` and a `~1,500 sf` dry-side moisture rework pass near Grid E-4 on `06/30/2026` (Lift 5, row `R23`). However, **none of the underlying reports `FDR-BA-01` through `FDR-BA-05` are in the project verification record**. Given Vantree's use of the wrong Proctor and omission of moisture limits on `SF-26-0708`, Thelbridge cannot verify from the Contractor's summary log alone whether Lifts 1–5 met both $\gamma_d \ge 122.0\text{ pcf}$ and $8.2\% \le w \le 11.2\%$ against `VMT-25-0918-P04`.
3. **Unattached `RFI 079` Stockpile Gradation Retest (`Article 1.4.C`, `Article 3.7.A.2`, & `RFI 079` / `TPM-25-079`)**: `RFI 079` (closed `10/10/2025` via letter `TPM-25-079`) qualified the borrow stockpile north of Block C for reuse *"subject to gradation retest"*; that gradation retest confirming correspondence of the Block C stockpile to Sample `LWP-PA-SF-2025-01` (`VMT-25-0918-P04`) is not yet included in the verification record.
